d: The BCCI has appointed suspended Meghalaya Cricket Association (MCA) secretary Rayonald Kharkamni as North-East Zone convener for a national women’s T20 tournament, four months after the state association flagged his suspension and findings of negligence in handling sexual harassment complaints by women cricketers. The 26 October appointment for the BCCI Senior Women’s T20 Inter-Zonal Tournament 2026-27, scheduled from 24 November to 4 December, came despite the MCA having written to BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia on 27 June.
